prompt.project_info: Create a high-resolution vertical outfit-check photograph from directly above a wide indoor escalator.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman standing mid-step in a cropped varsity jacket, crisp white pleated mini skirt, tall white socks, red platform sneakers, and heart-shaped sunglasses. Preserve the playful fashion-forward styling and relaxed sideward gaze from the reference.
prompt.composition_elements: Top-down vertical composition with metallic escalator steps filling nearly the entire frame, horizontal ridges and bright yellow safety lines creating a clean graphic grid, minimal side-panel visibility, and the subject centered head to toe. Preserve any visible garment patches without inventing logos or text.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Even soft ambient indoor lighting, gentle highlights on pleats, knit socks, leather sneakers, sunglasses, and metal steps, spontaneous but polished outfit-check atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm lens look with natural compression, vertical full-body framing, high-resolution photorealism, realistic anatomy and material texture, subtle grain, balanced exposure, controlled saturation.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A high-resolution vertical photograph captured from directly above a wide indoor escalator, showing one approved adult woman standing mid-step in a clean graphic grid of metallic escalator steps. The steps fill nearly the entire frame with horizontal ridges and bright yellow safety lines. She wears a cropped varsity jacket, crisp white pleated mini skirt, tall white socks, bold red platform sneakers, and heart-shaped sunglasses, standing in a relaxed playful posture with her gaze casually directed to the side. Use an 85mm lens look, natural compression, even soft indoor lighting, realistic pleat, knit, leather, sunglass, and metal texture, subtle grain, and a polished spontaneous fashion-check mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, child or teen appearance, unsafe escalator behavior, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, invented logos, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
